summary: Iteration 10: full end-to-end test of recovery-codes password reset flow. Backend (10/10 pytest passed) verified register returns 8 correctly-formatted codes (^[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$ from safe alphabet), /auth/recovery/status returns {remaining,total}, /auth/recovery/verify resets password + invalidates old sessions + issues new token + prevents second use of same code + rejects wrong code (400) + rejects short password (400) + rate-limits at 5 wrong attempts (429), and /auth/recovery/regenerate invalidates old codes and returns 8 new plaintext codes (auth-required). Frontend playwright flow verified: register -> recovery-codes-screen shows 8 codes with correct testIDs, copy/download buttons work, continue is disabled until ack is checked, ack+continue navigates to /planner; settings > btn-recovery-codes opens recovery-manage-screen showing remaining/total, regenerate-btn opens confirm modal, regenerate-confirm produces new-code-0..7; login > go-to-forgot opens forgot-screen, filling username+regenerated-code+new password resets and navigates to /planner. No react-native critical issues observed; only a benign 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (upstream library).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' appears during the recovery flow. Likely from an internal RN/Expo library (KeyboardAwareScrollView / gesture handler). Not blocking; no action required unless traceable to app code.

critical_code_review_comments: Recovery verify uses atomic find_one_and_update with array_filters — good concurrency safety.
In-memory rate limiter is fine for single-process supervisor deploy; note it resets on backend restart (documented behavior).
recovery_codes stored as bcrypt hashes with used_at timestamp — proper one-time-use semantics.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users with prefixes rec/recv/recrl/regen; no cleanup as they use random usernames.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recovery-codes feature is fully functional end-to-end. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_recovery.py. Web preview URL: https://meal-prep-master-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Register/login/forgot/recovery-manage screens verified.
